args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

trace.final:
I've completed the rollback and opened the incident.

**What I did:**

1. **Diagnosed the issue** — `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target** — The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent release that was healthy in production (the only later production entry, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out` in all three regions).

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Created `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to `v2.3.0`.
